CONTEXT.content: You can't operate what you can't see. Production readiness starts with observability: logs, metrics, and health checks that tell you when something is wrong before users report it.
CONTEXT.analogy: A car dashboard shows speed, fuel, and warning lights — you don't open the hood while driving to check the engine.
CONTEXT.productionNote: Teams without health checks discover outages from Twitter, not monitoring.
hints: What would you want to know if your server stopped responding at 3am?

DECIDE.optionA: Add /health endpoint that checks DB connectivity and returns structured JSON status.
DECIDE.optionB: Add process-level metrics only (memory, uptime) without dependency checks.

tradeoffs.A: Catches dependency failures; health check itself can cause load.
tradeoffs.B: Lightweight; misses DB/network failures until users hit errors.

hints: What does 'healthy' mean for your URL shortener?

BUILD.goal: Implement GET /health returning { status, uptime, db: ok|fail } with dependency checks.

tracks.node: Add health route with DB ping. Log structured JSON on each request.
tracks.typescript: Bun.serve health handler with sqlite check.

acceptance: /health returns 200 with status ok when DB is up
hints: Health checks should be fast — under 100ms.
Don't put secrets in health response.

criteria: Show curl /health when DB is stopped (503)
Explain what an orchestrator would do with these responses
hints: Kubernetes uses health checks to restart failing pods.

BREAK.scenario: Deploy passes health checks but users report 500s on /links.
BREAK.symptoms: /health returns ok. /links fails. Logs show intermittent DB timeouts.
hints: Is /health testing the same code path as /links?
Liveness vs readiness — what's the difference?

FIX.goal: Split liveness and readiness, or deepen health check to catch the real failure mode.
hints: Liveness: is process alive? Readiness: can it serve traffic?

decisionCallbacks.A: Dependency checks in /health would have caught the DB issue — if readiness used the same path as real traffic.
decisionCallbacks.B: Process metrics looked fine while the app couldn't serve — proving uptime ≠ healthy.
